fnol_text: My name is Yusuf O'Connell and I live at 709 Elmstead Drive, Greenville, SC 29615. You can reach me on (555) 590-3985 or yusuf.oconnell@example.com. My car was stolen from outside the house overnight on 21 September 2023. Glass from the driver's window was on the road. Policy MT-2024-00019. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs O'Connell on (555) 590-3985 to acknowledge the claim. Yusuf confirmed the loss date as 21 September 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Hiroshi Lindqvist gave a statement by phone.
